instruction: Candid family photograph, medium shot. Indoors in front of a white-paned glass door, the woman in the coral hoodie (R1) stands on the left, smiling as she holds the hand of the young blonde girl in the blue dress (R3) high in the air. The girl (R3) sits happily on the shoulders of the bald man with glasses (R2), who stands on the right smiling down. The man (R2) holds the girl's leg for support while she and the woman (R1) raise their clasped hands. Soft, natural indoor light illuminates the warm scene.
